newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) candidate won Monday's parliamentary by-elections in the Manikganj-3 constituency.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina left for Tokyo in the early hours of Tuesday on a six-day official visit to Japan.
The cabinet on Monday abolished a proposal for the annulment of the Drama Performance Act, 1876, and decided to formulte a policy to prevent infiltration of alien culture.
Eight members of a family, including three children, were strangulated to death Monday night in Chandpur district over land dispute.
The 1997/98 budget was passed in the parliament late on Monday amid walkout by the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
Five foreign firms have submitted their proposals for installation of the proposed 300 megawatt power station near Dhaka.
China has expressed interest to invest in the Export Processing Zone in Chittagong.
Fertility rate of Bangladeshi women decreased to 3.3 percent in 1997 from 7 percent in 1975. REUTER
